question: Who among the following was the first president of Indian Olympic Association?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir **Dorabji Tata.__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Olympic Association (IOA)__

 
 
• The Indian Olympic Association is the body for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Gaines and other international athletic meets.
 
• It also manages the Indian teams at the events.
 
• It was formed in 1927 and was officially recognised by the International Olympic Committee as India's National Olympic organisation.
 
• **The first president of this association was Sir Dorabji Tata.**
 
• PT Usha becomes the first woman President of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
• The tasks taken up by this association have been:
 
 
• Sending teams to the Olympics
 
• Securing Funds
 
• Holding National Games
